allow: PowerShell(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "pg" -or $_.DisplayName -match "postgres" } | Select-Object Name, Status, DisplayName)
PowerShell(Get-WmiObject Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq "postgresql-x64-16" } | Select-Object Name, StartName, PathName)

PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"wrong"}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object StatusCode, StatusDescription; $err = $null; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/login" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"wrong"}' } catch { $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ })
